name: inline-target
source:
from noscheme import role as r, nettype, unused as u, num as n, std
component Part:
  params:
    value: number = 1
  pins:
    1: r.passive
board B:
  global net vcc: nettype.power
block Unit:
  params:
    count: number = 2
    resistance: number = 4700
  ports:
    signal: nettype.passive
  net wire: nettype.passive
  inst x: Part(1: |)
